result.question: Why did Uzziah dig cisterns?

readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly says, “Since he had much livestock… he… dug many cisterns,” tying the cisterns to livestock; “lover of the soil” explains his farmers and vinedressers, not the cisterns.

result.reason: The text links digging cisterns to having much livestock, whereas the key gives a different reason (loving farming).
